exposure: Individualized lifestyle intervention (diet, exercise, weight monitoring)
outcome: Number of neonates referred to the NICU
cohort: The study included 355 pregnant women with normal pre-pregnancy BMI, enrolled before 12 weeks of pregnancy.
finding: The intervention group experienced lower gestational weight gain, less excessive gestational weight gain, lower incidence of hypertension, and lower neonate birth weight compared to the control group.
mod_finding: There were no statistically significant differences in delivery mode between the intervention and control groups.
